item.title: Beloved Game Studio’s Fate Looks Grim after Xbox Abandons It
item.description: In July, Microsoft announced a "reset" for Xbox , a euphemism for the over 3,000 layoffs it plans to make at Xbox between July 2026 and 2027. Those layoffs included a couple studios being forced to go independent , but the fate of others was unclear. Microsoft told Dishonored and Marvel's Blade developer Arkane Studios' management on July 16 that it intended to close the studio. But because Arkane is based in Lyon, France, Xbox has had to adhere to French labor laws and therefore could not close Arkane right away.

item.title: Plan to Save BioWare and Mass Effect Proposed by Canadian Politician
item.description: The game industry is still reeling from the announcement that EA and its new private equity investors shut down the legendary BioWare . The studio was one of the medium's most renowned developers, known for Mass Effect , Dragon Age, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic , Jade Empire , and more. Shortly after the news came out, a former BioWare developer reportedly leaked a trailer for the unreleased Mass Effect Universe , which rubbed salt in the wound.

item.title: Ridley Scott's Action Epic Finds Redemption as the No. 1 Hit on Streaming
item.description: Ridley Scott takes his sweet time when delivering on sequels. The acclaimed director, whose original post-apocalyptic thriller The Dog Stars comes to streaming this month , took 33 years before returning to the Alien franchise (for better or worse) with 2012's Prometheus . He turned around a sequel relatively quickly with 2017's Alien: Covenant . Before any of that, Scott directed a sequel to another filmmaker's work, releasing The Silence of the Lambs follow-up Hannibal in 2001.

item.title: Lord of the Rings Stars to Reunite for Netflix's The Gentlemen
item.description: Production is now underway for the third season of Netflix's The Gentlemen , and with it comes a host of new casting announcements. Guy Ritchie's action-comedy-crime drama starring Theo James is adding a host of famous faces, including not one but two members of The Fellowship of the Ring .

item.title: Mass Effect Spiritual Successor Officially Reveals Redesigned Protagonist
item.description: When Exodus was first announced, it was positioned as a sprawling sci-fi RPG that could fill the void left by Mass Effect 's extended absence. This week, that became even more relevant following Electronic Arts' announcement that Mass Effect developer BioWare was being shut down and the next game in the series was canceled.

item.title: 5 Sci-Fi Books That Are A Masterclass In Prose Writing
item.description: Although most good sci-fi books boast well-written prose, some stand out for several reasons. Take Time of Changes by Robert Silverberg, which is set in a world that forbids expressions of individuality, leading to a narrator who deliberately rebels by using terms like “I” or “me” repeatedly. Conversely, some books simply feature beautiful prose without any narrative gimmicks, elevating them to must-reads. Without further ado, here are five sci-fi books that are a masterclass in prose.

item.title: Which chapter should you choose first in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4?
item.description: Once you've completed the tutorial and the first page of orders, you'll be asked to choose one of three DMZ chapters in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 . The game tells you that the ones you don't choose will be available to you later on, so you're not locked out of them entirely, but it does mean you should prioritize the chapter that will offer you the best rewards.
